messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
You seem to be under some sort of impression that this person was way more into you than they actually were, and that they have nothing better to do than make you the center of their life.

output.original_text: You seem to be under some sort of impression that this person was way more into you than they actually were, and that they have nothing better to do than make you the center of their life.
output.joy: It's wonderful how you think this person was really into you, like they wanted to make you the center of their world!
output.sadness: It's hard to see you believe this person cared so deeply, when the truth is they never really made you a priority at all.
output.fear: It’s alarming to think you might honestly believe that this person was so invested in you, when they may not have been at all.
output.anger: It's infuriating to see you convinced that this person was into you, as if they should have made you their whole world!
output.surprise: I can’t believe you think this person was so into you! It’s shocking they weren’t as invested as you thought.
output.disgust: It’s pretty ridiculous that you think this person was so into you that they would make you their entire life.
